Name: Verumew's Portraits
Author: verumew
Description:
Hello, I'm Veri (verumew) and I'm a freelance artist!
You can find me on [url=https://twitter.com/verumew]Twitter[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.instagram.com/verumew/]Instagram[/url].

You can also ﻿[url=https://ko-fi.com/verumew]support me on Ko-fi[/url] or order [url=https://verumew.carrd.co/]commissions[/url]﻿ from me!
[u]
[b][size=3]
ABOUT THE MOD﻿
[/size][/b][/u][size=3]
[/size]The portrait mod was initially going to be just for Sebastian but I decided to slowly add more characters to it! It contains a sheet of basic portraits including the beach and winter versions. 
I will be adding more portraits gradually!
[b]
For any issues email me at:[/b] verumew@gmail.com


[quote][b]﻿UPDATE [10/11/2025][/b]

Added portraits for: Alex, Elliott, Shane, Haley, Leah, Maru with a different hairstyle.
Updated the portraits of: Abigail, Maru, Robin, Penny (might update Penny again in the close future).

With this update all bachelors and bachelorettes are available + Robin and Jodi!

You can change Maru's hairstyle, Sam's shirt color and Sebastian's beach outfit by changing the names of their portraits.
[i](ex. Sebastian_IslandSouth_NoShirt →  Sebastian_IslandSouth / Sam_YellowShirt  → Sam)[/i]
[b]Please make sure the spelling is accurate to the original name!![/b] For example Maru_Winter will not work because it needs to be written as Maru_winter (lowercase!)[/quote]
[size=1][b]_______________________________________________________________________________[/b]
[/size][color=#efefef][size=1]
[/size][/color][b][u][size=4]INSTRUCTIONS FOR 1.6 VERSION

[/size][/u][/b][size=2]---[b] HOW TO INSTALL THE MOD[/b] ---

﻿﻿1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]. This will create a [u]Mods[/u] folder in the game's files.
    [i] ﻿The folder should be here for most users: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods [/i][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows][i](tutorial on how to use smapi)[/i]
[/url]﻿ ﻿2. Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture
[/url] ﻿3. Download "[Portraiture] Verumew Portraits" and extract the folder within
﻿4. Place "VerumewPortraiture" in[b] "Mods/Portraiture/Portraits"[/b]
﻿5. Start the game with SMAPI and talk to someone. Once the DialogueBox is open press P to change portraits until my portraits show up.
[/size]
[size=2]   To use my additional portraits rename them: Sebastian_IslandSouth_NoShirt →  Sebastian_IslandSouth / Sam_YellowShirt  → Sam[/size]

[b]__________________________________________________________
[/b]
[b][u][size=4]INSTRUCTIONS FOR 1.5 VERSION[/size]
[/u][size=2]
[/size][/b][size=2]--- [b]HOW TO INSTALL THE MOD [/b]---

﻿1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]. This will create a [u]Mods[/u] folder in the game's files.
﻿The folder should be here for most users: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows] ﻿here is a better tutorial on how to use smapi[/url]
﻿2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and my mod, then unzip them into the [u]Mods[/u] folder
[color=#ff0000][b]             Be sure to check the versions of HD Portraits, Content Patcher and SMAPI to ensure safely running ver 1.5![/b][/color]
﻿3. Launch Stardew Valley using SMAPI

And you're done! ☆

--- [b]HOW TO CHANGE SETTINGS IN THE MOD[/b] ---

To change Sam's shirt to yellow:
﻿1. Open the config.json file with Notepad from "[HDP] Verumew's Portraits"
﻿2. Replace "false" with "true"
﻿3. Save
___________

To use the [b]Datable Jodi[/b] portraits:[color=#efefef]
[/color] ﻿1. Open the config.json file with Notepad from "[HDP] Verumew's Portraits"
﻿2. Replace "false" with "true"
﻿3. Save

If later on you decide to [b]delete [/b]the original Datable Jodi mod:
﻿1. Open the config.json file with Notepad from "[HDP] Verumew's Portraits"
﻿2. Replace "true" with "false" 
﻿3. Save

[/size][u][b][size=2]The Datable Jodi portraits are set to "false" by default.[/size]
[/b][/u]
__________________________________________________________

[size=2]Past updates:
[color=#cccccc]
[/color][/size][size=1][color=#b6b6b6][b]UPDATE [23/05/2024][/b]
[Portraiture]
Portraits for Emily and Penny have been added and Abigail now wears a bow by default!
You can remove Abby's bow, change Sam's shirt color and change Sebastian's beach outfit by changing the names of their portraits.
(ex. Abigail_no_bow  → Abigail)[/color]
[/size][color=#b6b6b6][size=1]
[b]UPDATE [07/05/2024][/b]
My portraits are now ready to be used in version 1.6 with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]!
Included are the base, beach and [b]winter [/b]portraits of Sebastian, Maru, Abigail, Sam, Harvey, Robin and Jodi.
During testing I saw that in winter the characters will wear their winter outfits [b]all the time [/b]even when they are inside their houses. There's no way for me to fix that (at least as of my knowledge) so I hope you guys won't mind that discrepancy!
I've added Sebastian's no shirt version for the beach outfits and Sam's yellow shirt (which matches the original portrait). To use those portraits rename them as: Sebastian_IslandSouth_NoShirt →  Sebastian_IslandSouth / Sam_YellowShirt  → Sam
[b]ENJOY!! <3[/b]
NOTE: I will definitely look into making the mod compatible with HD Portraits as soon as it gets updated for 1.6.﻿

[/size]
[size=1][b]UPDATE [26/04/2024][/b]
The portraits for 1.6 (winter outfits and any new changed portraits from the basic and beach versions) are ready to be added to this mod. [u]The files will be released after HD Portraits has been made compatible with 1.6 and after I've checked if everything runs smoothly![/u]
The portraits that are ready to be added: Sebastian, Robin, Maru, Sam, Harvey and Jodi.
I've adjusted the Datable Jodi ones too, but those will not be able to run in 1.6 without the original mod's update. So I will include them for older versions.
[b]A new addition[/b] is also a topless Sebastian beach portrait, since I've seen some people who might want to toggle that on :3c It's only the portrait since I don't know how to change his actual attire (yet).
I made a [url=https://trello.com/b/7DOfHm0Y/sdv-portrait-mod]page [/url]﻿where you can see my general progress!
Thank you for the patience, I hope you will enjoy my portraits when they release!![/size]

[/size][/b][/color][size=1]   [color=#cccccc] - Added portraits for Maru, Harvey and Sam! Sam has two portrait versions - with red shirt and yellow shirt.[/color][color=#b6b6b6][b]

2. Replace "false" with "true"
3. Save
